note: Vortex is NOT deployed to public Arbitrum One. This file is intentionally empty and kept so the absence is explicit rather than looking like an oversight. Evidence comes from a pinned Arbitrum One fork (see forkBlock) or from local chain 31337. Fork runs write to 42161.fork.json, which is gitignored precisely so fork addresses can never be mistaken for mainnet deployments.
reason: Pricing reads MockReferenceOracle, an owner-set feed. Deploying that to mainnet and presenting it as a reference price would be the same mock-as-live misrepresentation this project rejects elsewhere, and a production oracle integration is out of scope for the hackathon build.
